text:
elaine: quick huddle — we need a compact ops checklist for launch posts: target KW list, JSON-LD for webinar + benchmark pages, a simple internal-link matrix (seed → clusters), and redirect rules for legacy blog slugs. target: lock edits by EOD Thu.
marco: ok i'll own KW + anchor CSV. focusing on feature queries, benchmark comparisons, and integration how-tos. will keep it to ~15 targets.
jamal: i'll prepare two schema snippets (Event + Article). paste Event into the head and validate with Rich Results Test. tiny Event example to use: ```json
{"@context":"https://schema.org","@type":"Event","name":"Redwood Inference Launch Webinar","startDate":"2026-04-14T17:00:00Z","location":{"@type":"VirtualLocation","url":"https://redwood.ai/webinar"}}
```
sophia: i exported pre-2024 /blog/* slugs into the Redirects sheet (drive link in thread). proposal: 302 test window 7–14 days then convert to 301. infra window requested 02:00–04:00 UTC.
elaine: add an "anchor_rewrite" column that maps CTAs back to /webinar (primary) and /demo-request (secondary). keep promo posts to a single CTA.
marco: internal-link plan: seed (launch overview) -> clusters [benchmark, integration, pricing, migration, case study]. anchor examples: "benchmark results", "how to integrate", "cost vs performance", "migration steps", "customer story". limit 2 contextual links to each cluster. i'll output CSV with columns: source_url, target_url, anchor_text, reason.
seo-bot: crawl-scan: benchmark-drafts shows 6 images missing alt text and 2 broken internal links (rows flagged in sheet).
jamal: small QA note — include Article.mainEntityOfPage + image objects in Article JSON-LD for better rich snippets. i'll run a smoke validation after snippets are added.
sophia: sample nginx rules for infra (in sheet comments): ```nginx
# temp 302 for testing
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 redirect;
# promote to 301 after QA window
rewrite ^/old-blog/(.*)$ /new-blog/$1 permanent;
```
elaine: final checklist by EOD Thu:
- marco: KW list + anchor CSV in drive
- jamal: schema snippets + validation report
- sophia: redirect sheet + infra ticket + rollout window
- elaine: copy QA + CTA placement (primary CTA = webinar signup)
marco: ack :thumbsup:
sophia: ack, will ping infra after sheet signoff
jamal: ack, will queue validation once JSON-LD is live
elaine: note: keep outreach CTAs lightweight; we'll iterate CTA language after the first benchmark week. :rocket:
